photos.title: Photos
photos.intro: Customers see these on your shop page. The first photo is the cover.
photos.full: You have reached the limit of {{max}} photos. Remove one to add another.
photos.emptyText: Add a few photos of your shop so customers know what to expect.

add.title: Add a photo
add.fileHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{max}} MB.
add.altHint: Optional. Say what the photo shows, for example "Facial room". Up to {{max}} characters.

remove.title: Remove this photo?
remove.text: The photo will no longer be shown on your shop page.

tour.title: Virtual tour
tour.intro: Add a link to a virtual tour of your shop. Customers can open it from your shop page.
tour.label: Tour link
tour.hint: A link that starts with https://. Leave it empty to show no tour.
tour.open: Open the tour in a new tab

errors.too_many: You can have up to {{maxPhotos}} photos.
errors.bad_type: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP picture.
errors.too_big: The picture is larger than 2 MB.
errors.read_failed: Could not read the picture. Try again.
errors.alt_too_long: The description can be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.bad_url: Enter a link that starts with https:// and is at most {{urlMax}} characters.
errors.not_found: This photo no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.failed: Could not save. Please try again.
